description: This source file defines the class ProcessStatusWindow, which manages execution of external commands, monitors their output streams, and updates a UI window accordingly. It includes methods for checking the OS type, executing commands with process handling, stream reading, and thread management.

classes.name: ProcessStatusWindow
classes.description: Main class for managing process execution, stream reading, and UI updates for process status.

methods.name: isWindows
methods.description: Checks if the operating system is Windows.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Determines if a given process is still running.

methods.name: startStreamThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to read a process stream, update UI, and accumulate output.

methods.name: executeCommand
methods.description: Executes a command, manages process output, and updates UI with logs.

methods.name: submitAction
methods.description: Submits a Runnable task to a new daemon thread.
